environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. TLS termination at the instance via nginx reverse proxy to localhost:8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer inspection. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume with default permissions.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener (no HTTP inspection)
